column1: # counts: fixed generator (gen_reason_deletion.py, pure function of units) + the driver's
#   tier  units  abox_triples  rdfs_closure  owl_mono_closure  owl_fixpoint_closure
# abox_triples = units*8 (generator-drift gate). Closure columns are the incremental
# closure sizes; the driver already asserts each equals the from-scratch closure, so
# pinning them here pins BOTH maintenance and batch materialization.
# [OPUS-4.8] sq-x58ow FIXED (parent sq-6tykl.4): the driver's delete-sampler now mirrors
# `MaterializedOwlGraph::triggers_rebuild` — it excludes the six TBox predicates AND
# axiom-typing triples (`p == rdf:type` && axiom-class object, e.g.
# [locatedIn, rdf:type, owl:TransitiveProperty]) AND occurrence-guarded ids — so no ABox
# delta can spuriously take the rebuild path. Tier unit counts are now ROUND (3000, not the
# old draw-safe 3020); re-validate with run.sh if the driver or generator changes.
